assessment_summary: I inspected the workspace, runtime processes, ports, Docker containers, database, and exercised the application over HTTP. The guide's prerequisites are all present at the exact versions declared in .ruby-version/.tool-versions, dependencies are satisfied, PostgreSQL has a migrated schema (64 tables) and the seeded super_admin user, and the docker-compose dependencies (Tika, Mailpit) are running. The app is reachable on localhost:3000 following the documented bin/dev method, serves the Vue/Vite frontend, and a full Devise login using the seeded admin credentials succeeds and yields an authenticated session. I could not observe the browser-rendered SPA (no headless browser), but the server-rendered shell plus the 200 responses for Vite entry modules and successful authentication provide strong behavioral evidence. Some environment shell quirks (a couple of curl/sed one-liners exited non-zero) did not affect the decisive checks, which were re-run successfully. Overall the installation is complete and operational.
